summary: Independent verification of Nifty 500 Value 50 (v50) data integrity. Wrote pytest suite that (a) fetched official Price + TRI history directly from niftyindices.com (session-primed) and (b) parsed the Excel workbook, comparing both against stored /app/build/data_snapshots/latest.json for 6 representative dates (2005-04-01, 2010-01-04, 2015-06-01, 2020-03-23, 2023-12-29, 2026-09-28) plus base/latest sanity checks. All 15 tests PASSED with tolerance 0.05. Frontend simulator loads at preview URL, v50 chip renders, simulation runs successfully and results-table shows the 'Nifty 500 Value 50' row (Avg Rolling 19.43%, Worst Floor -20.96%, Proj. Corpus ₹24,33,645). Conclusion: stored v50 Price and TRI values match both the official niftyindices.com API and the source Excel workbook exactly — the user's doubt is not substantiated by the data.
critical_code_review_comments: The data-testid='pick-v50' is applied to a hidden <input type=checkbox>. This works functionally but Playwright's default (visible=True) waits will fail. Consider moving the data-testid to the visible label/chip for easier automation, or exposing both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v50 data integrity confirmed against both live niftyindices.com API (Price + TRI endpoints) and the Excel workbook. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_v50_data_integrity.py can be re-run any time and will fetch fresh official data. It uses tolerance 0.05. Sample dates: 2005-04-01 (base=1000/1000), 2010-01-04, 2015-06-01, 2020-03-23, 2023-12-29, 2026-09-28 (latest=15341.50/26160.57). All PASS.
rca of the issue: No issue found. Stored v50 Price/TRI values exactly match both the official niftyindices.com API and the source Excel workbook across all 6 sampled dates spanning the full 2005-2026 range.
